security.csp: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self' 'wasm-unsafe-eval'; worker-src 'self' blob:; img-src 'self' blob: data:; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; connect-src 'self' ipc: http://ipc.localhost

bundle.shortDescription: PDF pages: reorder, rotate, delete, merge, extract
bundle.longDescription: Capriole works on PDF files on your computer: reorder, rotate, duplicate, delete, merge and extract pages. Files never leave the device.
